screening_results.reason: Meets full-text inclusion: I3 (empirical English MRI study comparing GM volume between PTSD patients and controls via VBM), I4 (reports whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast), I5 (results reported as coordinates/tables), I6 (controls are trauma-exposed survivors without PTSD, an acceptable control group). No full-text exclusion criteria (E4-E9) apply based on the NeuroStore record. Full text appears readable from the record.

Record describes an English-language empirical VBM study comparing PTSD patients (n=12) and matched non-PTSD fire survivors (n=12) using whole-brain voxelwise analysis of gray matter density with between-group contrasts and reported peaks. This meets I3, I4, I5 and I6; no exclusion criteria from E4–E9 apply based on the record.

NeuroStore record shows only within-group voxelwise regressions among a sample of veterans (some met PTSD criteria) and does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts of PTSD patients versus controls. Therefore full-text inclusion criteria I3 and I4 (empirical MRI study reporting GM volume differences between PTSD patients and controls; at least one whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast of PTSD patients vs controls) are not met. The record explicitly indicates analyses are within-group regressions and reports peaks from those models. This matches exclusion criterion E8 (studies reporting only within-group results without a qualifying between-group contrast).

Record shows an empirical English-language VBM MRI study comparing GM between PTSD patients and trauma-exposed controls (I3). It reports at least one whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast of PTSD vs controls (analysis_0) comparing GM volume (I4). Results are reported in the record (acceptable per I5). Controls are trauma-exposed victims without PTSD, acceptable per I6. No exclusion criteria (E4–E9) are met by the record.

Record indicates an empirical MRI morphometry study in English comparing PTSD patients and controls (I3). Spatial scope is whole-brain voxelwise and reports between-group voxelwise GM volume contrasts and peak coordinates (I4, I5). Control groups include healthy/non-PTSD participants which are acceptable (I6). No exclusion criteria (E4-E9) are met by the record.

Record reports an empirical structural MRI morphometry study comparing PTSD patients and healthy controls (I3). The analysis is voxelwise whole-brain morphometric (gray matter density) with whole-brain spatial scope and reported coordinates (I4). Results are reported (reported peaks) and acceptable in tables/figures (I5). Controls are healthy participants (I6). No exclusion criteria from the record apply.

Record reports an empirical English-language VBM study comparing GM volume between PTSD patients and controls (I3). NeuroStore indicates whole-brain spatial scope and between-group voxelwise contrasts (I4); results reported (OFC) satisfy I5; control groups include non-PTSD cancer survivors and healthy subjects (I6). No full-text exclusion criteria are clearly met in the record.

The NeuroStore record indicates this is an empirical MRI study of grey matter (I3 met). It reports voxelwise results and coordinate peaks (I5 met) and uses acceptable control groups (I6 met). However the record does not report any whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast directly comparing PTSD patients versus controls on gray matter volume (I4 not met). The listed analyses are a within-group cross-subject regression (analysis_0) and between-group interaction contrasts of a correlation (analyses_1 and _2), not a straightforward voxelwise patients>controls or patients<controls GM contrast. Therefore the full-text inclusion criterion I4 is not satisfied based on the NeuroStore record.

Meets full-text inclusion criteria: I3 empirical English structural MRI study assessing gray matter volume/density differences between PTSD patients and controls; I4 reports a whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast (SPM voxelwise analysis, whole brain); I5 results reported as voxelwise peaks/tables; I6 controls are healthy age- and gender-matched. No full-text exclusion criteria are met based on the record.

NeuroStore record indicates an empirical structural MRI morphometry study in English comparing PTSD patients and healthy controls on gray matter volume using whole-brain voxelwise analyses with reported significant peaks (meets I3, I4, I5, I6). No full-text exclusion criteria (E4-E9) are indicated by the record.

The record shows empirical MRI VBM analyses of grey matter volume in PTSD patients and controls (I3 met). Results (peaks) are reported in tables (I5 met). Control groups are acceptable (I6 met). However, the record does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group (PTSD vs controls) GM-volume contrast: the VBM between-group result that exists is reported with small-volume correction / ROI correction (Analysis 26441695_analysis_0) and other VBM/between-group entries indicate non-GM measures (cerebral blood flow) or are within-group only. Therefore full-text inclusion I4 is not met and exclusion E4 (only ROI/SVC results with no qualifying whole-brain results) applies.

Record describes an empirical voxel-based morphometry study in English comparing PTSD patients to controls (I3). It reports whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts (spatial scope: whole brain; coordinate space MNI) satisfying I4. Results are reported in tables of peaks (I5). Control groups include healthy and trauma-exposed without PTSD (I6). The record explicitly notes whole-brain analyses and reported peaks, so no full-text exclusion criteria are met.

The NeuroStore record does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast of PTSD patients versus controls comparing gray matter volume. The only structural morphometry result is a within-group (sexual assault participants) regression of self-blame against GMV. Thus the study fails full-text inclusion criteria I3 and I4 and is excluded under E8 (reports only within-group results without a qualifying between-group PTSD vs control GMV contrast). Full text appears readable from the record, so fulltext_incomplete=false.

The NeuroStore record describes an empirical VBM MRI study in English comparing grey matter density between PTSD patients and healthy controls (meets I3). It reports whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts of PTSD patients vs controls (analysis NS>S) and provides coordinates/tables (meets I4 and I5). Control population includes healthy participants (meets I6). No full-text incompleteness indicated and no exclusion criteria from E4–E9 are met by the record.

The NeuroStore record indicates an empirical MRI study measuring gray matter density volume differences between PTSD patients and controls (I3). At least one analysis (analysis_0) reports whole-brain voxelwise between-group GM results (voxel-level, uncorrected p<.001) satisfying whole-brain evidence (I4). Results are reported in tables of peaks (I5). Controls are trauma-exposed non-PTSD twins, which is an acceptable control population (I6). No full-text exclusion criteria (E4-E9) are met based on the record.

Meets inclusion: I3 (empirical English MRI study comparing GM volume between PTSD and controls), I4 (reports whole-brain VBM between-group contrasts), I5 (results reported in tables of coordinates), I6 (controls are healthy/non-traumatized). No exclusion criteria from E4-E9 are met based on the record.

The NeuroStore record shows only comparisons within PTSD patients (dissociative subtype vs non-dissociative subtype) and correlation analyses within the patient sample. It does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast of PTSD patients versus controls. Therefore full-text inclusion criteria I3 (PTSD vs controls) and I4 (whole-brain between-group PTSD vs controls) are not met. This meets exclusion criterion E8 (studies that report only within-group results in PTSD patients without a qualifying between-group contrast of PTSD patients vs controls).

The NeuroStore record indicates an empirical VBM study comparing PTSD patients to non-traumatized controls and reporting GMV decreases in hippocampi (meets I3 and I6). However, the record explicitly lists 'Spatial scope: region of interest' for all analyses and the reported between-group GMV comparison uses a combined hippocampal/amygdala mask rather than a whole-brain voxelwise analysis. No whole-brain between-group GMV contrasts are reported in the record (I4 not met). Therefore the study appears to report only ROI analyses and must be excluded under E4.

Record reports empirical MRI morphometric analyses comparing PTSD patients and healthy controls (I3). At least one whole-brain voxelwise between-group gray-matter volume contrast is reported (Analyses 30343133_analysis_0 and 30343133_analysis_1) meeting whole-brain evidence requirement (I4). Results are reported with peaks/tables (I5). Control group comprises non-traumatized healthy youths (I6). The record does include ROI/seed connectivity analyses but these do not negate inclusion because qualifying whole-brain GM contrasts are present. No exclusion criteria (E4–E9) are met for the study as a whole based on the record.

The study is an empirical VBM structural MRI study including PTSD patients and healthy controls (I3 met) and reports whole-brain voxelwise results for a combined patient group vs controls, but the NeuroStore record does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast specifically comparing PTSD patients versus controls. Full-text inclusion criterion I4 (must report at least one whole-brain voxel-wise PTSD vs control GM-volume between-group contrast) is not met. The record is otherwise complete enough to assess these criteria (fulltext_incomplete=false).

The NeuroStore record does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group (PTSD patients vs controls) GM volume contrasts required by I4. The only reported analysis is a within-group cross-subject regression in the PTSD group (not a patients vs controls comparison). Therefore full-text inclusion criteria I4 (and consequently I3 which requires assessment of GM differences between PTSD and controls) are not met. The record shows only within-group results, meeting exclusion criterion E8 (Studies that report only within group results in PTSD patients without a qualifying between-group contrast). fulltext_incomplete=false.

The NeuroStore record reports an empirical English-language VBM study comparing PTSD patients to both healthy controls and trauma-exposed controls (I3). It includes whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts (HC > PTSD and TC > PTSD) of grey matter volume with corrected inference reported (I4). Results are available in tables/peaks (I5). Control groups include healthy and trauma-exposed controls (I6). No full-text incompleteness is indicated and no exclusion criteria from E4-E9 are met based on the record.

NeuroStore record shows a VBM study and a within-group voxelwise regression in the PTSD subgroup (n=57) but does NOT report any whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrasts of PTSD patients vs controls. Therefore the required full-text inclusion criteria I3 (studies assessing GM volume differences between PTSD and controls) and I4 (at least one whole-brain voxel-wise between-group PTSD vs control contrast) are not met based on the record. The study therefore meets exclusion criterion E8 (reports only within-group results in PTSD patients without a qualifying between-group contrast). The record does not explicitly state between-group PTSD vs control GM contrasts; if such contrasts exist in the full text but were not extracted into the record, the record is incomplete on that point.

Meets I3: empirical English MRI VBM study assessing GM volume differences in PTSD patients and controls. Meets I4: reports whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast (Non-PTSD > PTSD) and analyses are labeled whole brain. Meets I5: results reported in tables of peaks. Meets I6: control group is trauma-exposed non-PTSD subjects. The NeuroStore record provides the necessary analysis-level information; full text appears readable (no fulltext_incomplete).

Record reports an empirical English-language MRI morphometry study of PTSD patients vs healthy controls assessing gray matter volume (meets I3). The NeuroStore record includes whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrasts with coordinates (analyses 28287194_analysis_2 and _3), satisfying I4. Results are reported in tables/peaks (I5). Controls are healthy participants, allowed by I6. No full-text incompleteness is indicated in the record.

The record describes an empirical English-language structural MRI VBM study comparing PTSD patients with trauma-exposed controls (meets I3 and I6). Results are reported as peaks/tables (meets I5). However, NeuroStore's record marks the spatial scope as 'region of interest' for all analyses and lists hippocampus and anterior cingulate as regions, indicating ROI-restricted reporting. Therefore the study does not provide a voxelwise whole-brain between-group contrast as required by I4. This meets exclusion criterion E4 (only ROI analyses). Although some inference lines state 'corrected within whole brain', the shared spatial-scope field explicitly indicates ROI analyses; based on the record we must treat this as ROI-only and exclude for E4. Inclusion criteria not met: I4.

The NeuroStore record reports only within-group voxelwise regression analyses in 28 PTSD patients relating symptom (flashback) scores to gray matter volume; it does not report any whole-brain voxelwise between-group contrast comparing PTSD patients vs controls. Therefore full-text inclusion criteria I3 and I4 (MRI studies reporting between-group GM volume contrasts of PTSD vs controls) are not met. Exclusion criterion E8 applies (studies that report only within-group results in PTSD patients without a qualifying between-group contrast). The record appears complete enough to make this determination (fulltext_incomplete=false).

I3 met: record shows an empirical structural MRI (gray matter volume) study in English comparing PTSD patients and controls (CAPS diagnosis). I6 met: controls include healthy and trauma-exposed individuals. I5 met: reported peaks indicate coordinates/tables are available. I4 NOT met: all analyses in the NeuroStore record list 'Spatial scope: region of interest' (ACC gyrus), so the paper does not report any voxelwise whole-brain between-group GM volume contrasts. Therefore E4 applies (studies reporting only ROI analyses with no qualifying whole-brain results). Full text appears readable from the record, so fulltext_incomplete=false.

The NeuroStore record indicates the reported analysis is a region-of-interest (ROI) analysis (Spatial scope: region of interest). This fails the full-text inclusion requirement I4 (must report at least one whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast). The record does indicate structural morphometry of gray matter (I3), but the ROI-only scope triggers exclusion under E4. The record does not show whole-brain voxelwise results.

Meets inclusion I3 (empirical English MRI study assessing GM differences between PTSD patients and controls) and I6 (control groups include non-maltreated healthy volunteers). Does NOT meet I4 (whole-brain voxel-wise between-group contrast) because NeuroStore record indicates analyses are region-of-interest / masked voxel-based morphometry (spatial scope='region of interest', inference corrected within ROI; 'masked voxel base morphometry' in abstract). Therefore excluded under E4 (ROI-only analyses).

The NeuroStore record indicates an empirical VBM study comparing PTSD and controls (I3 met) with reported coordinates (I5) and acceptable control groups (I6). However, the only between-group contrast (analysis 21418787_analysis_0) reports inference using small-volume correction / corrected within ROI (SVC), and all other analyses are within-group regressions. Thus the paper does not report a qualifying whole-brain voxelwise between-group PTSD vs control contrast (I4 not met). This meets exclusion E4 (reports only ROI/SVC analyses with no qualifying whole-brain results).
